Between that and the fact half our team is on CET/SGT split, the 11:30pm ET demo you proposed will push everyone to 3:30am SGT, which isn’t workable.

Hi Tom — appreciate the heads up. Totally understand the travel/offsite clash. We run both live and asynchronous options for tri-region demos depending on the customer's preference.

Proposal:
- Option 1 (Live): Move to next Tue/Thu morning ET so it's late afternoon in CET and evening in SGT. I can ask Rishi to lead a 45-min technical walkthrough and Grace to cover integration + security.
- Option 2 (Async): We record a focused 20–25 minute walkthrough (scripted, segmented by feature), upload to Loom, and follow with two 30-minute Q&A office hours (one timed for EMEA overlap, one for APAC). We can surface timestamps and a short index so folks can jump to the parts they care about.

If you prefer async, we typically: record a short intro + product demo, attach the agenda, link to a shared doc for questions, and schedule two live syncs for follow-up. I attached a one-page checklist we use to make sure the recording hits evaluation criteria.

Which would you prefer? If live, send two preferred windows and I’ll confirm availability. If async, I’ll schedule the recording for this week and share links + office hour slots.

—Vanessa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
